$comment: Newsroom team definition. scripts/newsroom-setup.mjs applies it to the project's Paperclip instance; run it again after any change (/newsroom setup). Budgets are USD per month and start conservative; adjust after a week of measured spend. Switched from the legacy single-agent scheduled task on 2026-10-23 (Lior approved); that task is paused.

company.name: Physical AI Magazine
company.goal: Publish an accurate bilingual (Hebrew + English) Physical AI issue every day by 07:30, update it at 13:00 and 19:00, and find the magazine's name.

defaults.$cwd: Agents work through C:\pam, a directory junction to this folder (mklink /J C:\pam "C:\pysical ai magazine"): Paperclip's cli engine breaks absolute paths that contain spaces on Windows.

routines.title: גיליון היום
routines.description: Open today's issue and run it through Reporter -> Fact-checker -> Language editor & Publisher, per newsroom/agents/editor-in-chief.md.

routines.title: עדכון צהריים
routines.description: Noon update of today's issue per newsroom/agents/editor-in-chief.md (new items only; market refresh always).

routines.title: עדכון ערב
routines.description: Evening update of today's issue per newsroom/agents/editor-in-chief.md (new items only; market refresh always).

routines.title: סבב שמות שבועי
routines.description: Propose 3 new name candidates per newsroom/agents/brand-designer.md and ask Lior to decide.
